Karthik / Matt —

Quick note from the audit perspective: make sure the SCIM provisioning results include group membership timestamps and a mapping of external role -> internal RBAC role. We typically recommend a separate, delegated service account for provisioning (no human creds), and that SCIM syncs only directory attributes necessary for role resolution (email, groups, employeeType).

Also, please add the expected retention period for provisioning audit logs (Concordia's baseline is 3 years).

— Tina

Hi Matt — thanks, and welcome. A couple of clarifying notes from the solutions side:
- For SAML: we support both HTTP-POST and HTTP-Redirect bindings for the SP. If you have a preferred binding let us know; otherwise we default to POST.
- For attribute mapping: please include NameID format you expect (email vs persistent).
- SCIM: our default schema supports group membership and an optional custom attribute (concordiaRole) if you want role mapping.
- Service accounts: we provide a short template for the account and a recommended least-privilege permission set — see service-account-template.txt.

If you can share Okta tenant and a test IdP admin, I can schedule a 45-minute configuration session with our infra engineer on 2027-05-14 at 2pm PT. Does that work?
